Executive Summary: Alteryx Workflow for Distribution Channel and Financial Data Processing

This executive summary outlines the purpose, scope, and technical details of an Alteryx workflow designed to process and analyze distribution channel and financial data. The workflow integrates multiple data sources, applies complex transformations, and generates actionable outputs to support operational and financial decision-making. Specifically, it focuses on aggregating and enriching data related to sales orders, billing, shipping, and handling costs, enabling streamlined reporting and enhanced visibility into key metrics such as invoice sales, rush order fees, and shipping charges.

The workflow ingests data from both manual inputs and database connections. Manual inputs include date-related fields and distribution channel information, while database connections extract detailed transactional data from tables such as tdmedpod and dbo.tableupdated_new_1000. These datasets contain critical business fields such as sales order dates, billing dates, warehouse IDs, distribution channel IDs, financial class descriptions, invoice amounts, and shipping costs. Through a series of transformations, the workflow cleanses, formats, and aggregates this data to produce outputs that are ready for reporting and analysis. The final dataset is exported as a CSV file, which can be used by business users for operational tracking and strategic planning.

Data Sources



  • Manual Date
  • Type: Manual Input
  • Description: Contains manually inputted date-related fields such as Start Date, End Date, and DateTime_Out for date calculations and filtering.
  • Channel
  • Type: Manual Input
  • Description: Provides distribution channel information, including DIST_CHNL and DIST_CHNL_DESC, for mapping and categorization.
  • tdmedpod
  • Type: Database
  • Description: Extracts transactional data using SQL queries, including fields such as RunDte, SO_Date, BILL_DTE, Invoices, Invoice_Lines, LANDED_COST, and EXT_FINAL_PRICE. This data is critical for calculating invoice sales and shipping costs.
  • dbo.tableupdated_new_1000
  • Type: Database
  • Description: Fetches aggregated and grouped data, including fields such as SO_AUDAT, FKDAT, WERKS, VTWEG, ZZFINCLASS, and various cost-related metrics. This data supports detailed financial analysis and reporting.

Key Transformations



  • DateTimeNow Tool: Generates the current date and time in the format 'yyyy-MM-dd' for use in date-related calculations.
  • Formula Tool: Calculates date fields such as Prior Week Start, Prior Week End, and Prior Month Start/End to enable time-based analysis.
  • MultiFieldFormula Tool: Replaces null or empty values with 0 across multiple fields, ensuring data consistency and completeness.
  • Summarize Tool: Aggregates key metrics such as LANDED_COST, EXT_FINAL_PRICE, and Fuel_Surcharge by grouping data on BILL_DTE.
  • Formula Tool: Creates new fields such as Rush_Order_Fee and Invoice_Sales using custom calculations to enrich the dataset.
  • Select Tool: Renames fields for clarity, such as changing P1M_Start to Start Date and P1M_End to End Date.

Outputs



  • CHresult.csv
  • Description: Final output exported as a CSV file containing enriched data fields such as RunDTE, SO_Date, BILL_DATE, Whs, DIST_CHNL_ID, Rush_Order_Fee, and COE_SHIP_HNDL_AMT. This file is used for operational reporting and financial analysis.

Containers & Annotations



  • Tool Containers: Logical grouping of tools for modular workflow design, such as separating input, transformation, and output processes.
  • Annotations: Documented implementation decisions, such as formulas for calculating shipping costs and handling fees, ensuring auditability and clarity.

Business Value



  • Improved Data Quality & Consistency
  • Null and empty value handling ensures accurate and complete datasets for analysis.
  • Enhanced Financial Insights
  • Aggregated metrics such as Invoice Sales and Shipping Costs provide actionable insights for cost optimization.
  • Operational Efficiency
  • Automated data processing reduces manual effort and accelerates reporting timelines.
  • Scalability & Reusability
  • Modular workflow design and reusable logic enable future enhancements and scalability.

Conclusion:

This Alteryx workflow effectively integrates, transforms, and enriches distribution channel and financial data to produce actionable outputs for operational and strategic decision-making. By automating complex calculations and ensuring data consistency, the workflow delivers significant business value, including improved reporting accuracy, enhanced financial insights, and operational efficiency.
